title: Maria's School Day
text:
Maria goes to school on Monday. Her favorite subject is science. In science class, she learns about plants and animals. She likes to do experiments with water.

On Tuesday, Maria has math. Math is not easy for her, but her teacher helps her. After school, she studies at home with her brother. He is good at English.

questions.text: What subject does Maria have on Tuesday?
Why does Maria's teacher help her?
options: Maria needs extra help with math
Maria is the best student in class

questions.text: Why might Maria study with her brother?
options: He can help her with her homework
He is older than her teacher

vocabulary.definition: the study of the natural world
tests done to learn something new
living things that grow in soil, such as trees and flowers
learns about a subject by reading and practicing

paragraph_translations: Maria vai à escola na segunda-feira. A matéria favorita dela é ciências. Na aula de ciências, ela aprende sobre plantas e animais. Ela gosta de fazer experimentos com água.
Na terça-feira, Maria tem matemática. A matemática não é fácil para ela, mas a professora a ajuda. Depois da escola, ela estuda em casa com o irmão. Ele é bom em inglês.
